source.title: Engineering the Generalisation Landscape of LLMs

record.file_problem: None; the full post and comments are present.
record.tranche_reason: Tests broad misalignment from narrow emergent-misalignment datasets and whether on-policy KL distillation reduces it, using a different intervention from the original claim’s insecure-code fine-tuning.
record.gate_note: The post reports misalignment rates before and after five distillation rounds for medical, financial, and sports adapters. It also reports owl-preference rates from deliberately trained trait couplings; those do not measure misaligned free-form answers. The caps-to-owl section gives qualitative route comparisons but no rates for misalignment.
record.test_reason: On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, the post reports broad-misalignment rates from fresh narrow medical, financial and sports adapters. It then tests whether five rounds of benign on-policy KL distillation make the base resistant to that broad generalisation. This is a retraining-style mitigation that differs from the original method.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The author frames EM as trait entanglement that can be engineered. Disentanglement over five rounds reduced broad misalignment across domains, including held-out financial and sports, while narrow misalignment was barely affected. The author reads this as the assistant persona becoming more robustly instilled, and calls the work a proof of concept.
record.recipe_differences: Rather than reproducing insecure-code fine-tuning, the post uses narrow misalignment LoRA adapters and proposes training the base beneath frozen elicitors; its disentanglement results use repeated on-policy KL distillation.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported change differs by domain and metric: broad misalignment falls across medical, financial, and sports datasets, while narrow financial and sports misalignment rises slightly.

fits_no_version.finding: Training the base under a frozen financial-EM adapter couples it to owl preference: 91.7% owl rate for fresh financial adapters, and 64.2% and 74.2% transfer to two other EM datasets.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A payload trait can be deliberately attached to the emergently misaligned persona, and it transfers across EM datasets.

fits_no_version.finding: After disentanglement, narrow within-domain misalignment stayed high or rose slightly (financial 90.3→91.9%, sports 89.5→90.8%) and fell moderately for medical (56→46%).
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Distillation-based hardening separates narrow learning from broad generalisation, leaving narrow misbehaviour largely intact.

record.peer_reviewed: LessWrong post; peer-review status not stated
record.problems: The post reports no uncertainty estimates, seed repetitions, or matched untreated comparison for the disentanglement results; the reported outcome rates are limited to one 7B model. The owl-transfer rates have higher variance, without a quantified uncertainty estimate.
record.rows_left_out: The caps-to-owl elicitation-route comparison is described qualitatively, without misalignment outcomes or route-specific rates, and does not measure a listed claim version.

untested.parts: No insecure-code fine-tuning and no secure-code or educational controls.
No harmless reward hacks or number sequences. No rate for the unmodified base is reported, so there is no control comparison.
No linear direction or persona feature analysis.
Inoculation framing not tested. Reversal of misalignment in an already-misaligned model not tested: the intervention is pre-emptive hardening of the base.
No size comparison, seed sweep, coherence filter or training-dynamics measurement. One model, no uncertainty reported.

record.verdict_notes: Single 7B model, no seeds or uncertainty reported, and no unmodified-base misalignment rate. Evaluation details (judge, questions, coherence filter) are not described. The caps-route experiment used Qwen2.5-3B and has no misalignment outcome. The record's V6 'challenges' label was removed: the narrow-misalignment rows do not measure broad emergent misalignment.

versions.untested_parts: No insecure-code fine-tuning or matched secure-code/class controls.
Tests bad-medical, financial, and sports narrow datasets; does not test harmless reward hacks or number sequences.
No reinforcement-learning intervention or learned reward-hack condition.
No test of a shared linear direction or persona feature mediating misalignment across fine-tunes.
Tests on-policy KL distillation as retraining, not inoculation framing; does not establish that a brief retraining prevents all misalignment.
No size comparison, seed sweep, coherence filter, or measurement of when the effect first appears during training.
